params.name: subscriberIds
params.description: Unique numeric ID of the subscriber you want to retrieve categories for. By default, the current subscriber ID is set.

items.docs:
Returns a list of available work order categories for one or several subscribers. Only a parent subscriber can get categories for child subscribers.
You can create a new category via the [POST /categories](/swagger/ui/index#/Categories/POSTv3_categories) method.

Creates a new work order category within a primary category.
For more information, refer to [Managing categories](https://servicechannel.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SCU/pages/556302506/Managing+Categories) in ServiceChannel University.
Returns a list of available primary categories of the current subscriber.

info.name: List categories that have a GL code mapping with a trade

params.name: locationId
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the location for which you want to retrieve categories that have a GL code mapping with the trade.

params.name: trade
params.description: Trade to retrieve categories with their associated GL codes for.

items.docs: Returns categories that have GL codes associated with the specified trade. Learn more about [managing GL codes](https://servicechannel.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SCU/pages/557645834/Managing+GL+Codes) in ServiceChannel University.
